For a full-time MBA in Canada, three schools come up most often:

  • Rotman School of Management (University of Toronto) — strongest Bay Street placement for finance careers.
  • Ivey Business School (Western) — case-method teaching, one-year format.
  • Smith School of Business (Queen's University) — highly recommended for its 12-month program and team-based culture.

Recent rankings back this up FT Canadian MBA rankings and Smith publishes its employment outcomes Smith MBA employment report.
